content.bridge_context: Traveling back in time to understand how the first cities and civilizations began in the Indian subcontinent.

units.title: What is Civilization?
units.explanation: A complex society where people live in cities, have a government, and use technology.
units.dual_language_instruction: How is a city different from a small village? / एक शहर एक छोटे से गाँव से किस तरह अलग है?

units.title: The Indus River
units.explanation: Early civilizations often started near rivers because of water for drinking and farming.
units.dual_language_instruction: Locate the Indus River on a map. / मानचित्र पर सिंधु नदी को खोजें।
